text:
On a careful start we read your report, and the lounge host looked into it. You said your companion animal was left waiting during the handoff process, that the directions at the lounge felt unclear, and that the support you expected from Aurelia Skyways did not arrive with the calm and speed you needed.

I am responding as the shift coordinator for the Companion Animal Travel Desk, and I want to be clear that this concern was taken seriously as soon as it reached us. The team has reviewed the handling notes, the welcome flow, and the communication chain around the boarding area. We expect every handler to use calm, humane methods around animals, and we expect the same steady care from the people guiding passengers through the lounge. When a traveler is worried, supervisors listen closely and act without delay.

Your report points to a breakdown in communication, not a lack of care for your animal, and that distinction matters. If the lounge host did not give clear guidance, that is not acceptable. If the transition to boarding felt abrupt, that also needs correction. The desk has already reminded the on-duty staff that passengers traveling with animals must be prepared with clear, respectful updates and visible support at each handoff. The welcome team is being reinforced on this point so that no traveler is left uncertain while their companion waits.

We are also checking whether the flow between reception, the escort route, and the aircraft side needs tighter coordination. That review is active now, and it is being handled with urgency. I cannot undo the delay you experienced, but I can state plainly that the matter is being addressed and that the staff involved have been instructed to follow the correct procedure from this point forward.

We appreciate that you wrote to us directly. Prompt, respectful communication is part of the service Aurelia Skyways owes to every traveler, and especially to those traveling with companion animals. We are sorry for the stress this caused, and we are working to make sure the next handoff is handled properly and without confusion.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
